content: Camphor (synthetic), menthol, and methyl salicylate plaster is a topical analgesic approved by the FDA for the temporary relief of minor muscle and joint pain caused by conditions such as simple backache, arthritis, strains, bruises, and sprains. It is applied externally to the affected area. Dosage and Administration: For adults, clean the affected area and remove the paper film from the plaster. Apply one plaster to the affected area no more than 3 to 4 times daily. For children aged 12 years and older, the same instructions apply as for adults. For children under 12 years of age, this product should not be used without consulting a physician, as improper use may be dangerous. Contraindications and Warnings: This product is for external use only. It contains natural rubber latex, which may cause allergic reactions in some individuals. Do not use on irritated or damaged skin, wounds, or with a heating pad. Avoid use if pregnant or nursing unless directed by a healthcare provider. Avoid contact with eyes or mucous membranes, and do not bandage the area tightly. Adverse Reactions: Reported adverse effects include seizures, nausea, vomiting, warmth, headache, confusion, vertigo, delirium, hallucinations, tremors, contact eczema, and elevated liver enzymes (e.g., lactate dehydrogenase, aspartate aminotransferase-to-alanine aminotransferase ratio). Use in Specific Populations: There is no specific FDA guidance on the use of this product during pregnancy, labor and delivery, nursing, or in pediatric, geriatric, or immunocompromised populations. There is also no specific guidance regarding its use in individuals with renal or hepatic impairment, or in relation to gender or race. Storage: Store the product in a tightly closed container at room temperature (15º to 30º C or 59º to 86º F) and away from sunlight. Patient Counseling Information: Stop use and consult a doctor if the condition worsens, symptoms persist for more than 7 days, or symptoms clear up and return within a few days. Discontinue use if excessive skin irritation, nausea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, or skin rash occurs. For arthritis-related pain, stop use if pain persists for more than 10 days, redness is present, or symptoms worsen. This product should not be used in children under 12 years of age without medical advice. Overdose: In the event of suspected overdose or poisoning, contact the National Poison Help hotline (1-800-222-1222) immediately. Alcohol Interaction: The interaction between alcohol and this product has not been established. Consult a healthcare provider for advice regarding alcohol consumption while using this medication. Brand Name: This product is marketed under the brand name 701 DIEDA ZHENGTONG YAOGAO MEDICATED PLASTER.
